name: Numeraire

subjectOf.text: Requiring data scientists to stake a cryptocurrency on their own predictions converts private confidence into a public signal, which enables the fund to select the optimal model and improve fund performance.
subjectOf.abstract: The staking process, in turn, enables Numerai to choose the optimal model and in the process improve the performance of its hedge fund.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
scope_conditions: describes Numerai's use of the Numeraire token as a staking mechanism

subjectOf.text: Requiring data scientists to stake a cryptocurrency on their own predictions is a workable remedy for overfitting, because the stake expresses confidence in live performance and lets the fund select the optimal model.
subjectOf.abstract: The staking process, in turn, enables Numerai to choose the optimal model and in the process improve the performance of its hedge fund.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Financial Technology and Hedge Funds (2019). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3409548
scope_conditions: crowdsourced modeling competition with a stakeable token

subjectOf.text: Numeraire's staking and prediction-based reputation mechanism, tuned to predictive accuracy, overlooks the ethical and contextual concerns that characterize AI dataset governance.
subjectOf.abstract: The narrow focus on predictive accuracy overlooks the broader ethical and contextual concerns that characterize AI governance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
scope_conditions: diverse dataset tasks such as medical annotation and content moderation
